title: Distributional Convergence of Empirical Entropic Optimal Transport and Statistical Applications
summary: Recently, the statistical properties of empirical Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) have attracted great interest, as this quantity has been shown to be useful for complex data analysis, among other reasons due to its computational efficiency. In several applications, it has been observed that the EOT plan provides valuable information beyond just the optimal value. For example, in cell biology, colocalization analysis based on the EOT plan has been introduced as a measure for quantification of spatial proximity of different protein assemblies.
